usage.source_scope: 交互关键点、多视角一致性与 docking point 优化。
usage.project_application: 作为 L10 action-ready 站位机制的参考，把“接近物体”改为“接近能执行目标动作的位置”。
usage.modifications: 不采用机器人手臂轨迹；保留 keypoint-to-stance 几何约束，并以用户可达/净空替代机械臂可达。
usage.expected_effect: 减少在错误侧面、距离虽近但不可操作的位置停止。

evaluation.setup: 未执行；最小证伪实验：冻结目标识别与导航轨迹，仅比较 nearest-target 与 interaction-keypoint stance；主指标为 ready-pose precision、distance-matched false-ready 和 wrong-side rate。
evaluation.claim_boundary: MoTo 的 OVMM/真实机器人结果未在 BlindAssist 复现；机器人 docking 增益不能外推为盲人导航、产品或安全能力。

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.
